title: De schokkende voordelen van minder luchtvervuiling: een voorbeeld uit Griekenland

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: het aantal winterse ziekenhuisopnames wegens hartproblemen bij de belangrijkste ziekenhuizen in de regio met 22 tot 42 procent terug

evidence_level.evidence: Tussen 2011 en 2021 daalde de hoeveelheid zwaveldioxide in de winter met meer dan 90 procent. Ook de concentratie fijnstof nam af. Tegelijkertijd liep het aantal winterse ziekenhuisopnames wegens hartproblemen bij de belangrijkste ziekenhuizen in de regio met 22 tot 42 procent terug.

change_durability.evidence: Mijnen gingen dicht, centrales werden gesloten en de luchtvervuiling nam sterk af.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: reduced air pollution leading to fewer heart hospitalizations

title: The silent crisis on our plates

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Today, when the house falls silent at night, the quiet is no longer a trigger. Instead of rummaging in the dark, she has found peace in a simple dish.

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: With her mother constantly by her side, backed by encouraging friends and a dedicated medical team, she was no longer fighting alone.

evidence_level.evidence: Today, when the house falls silent at night, the quiet is no longer a trigger. Instead of rummaging in the dark, she has found peace in a simple dish.

change_durability.evidence: For Haley, recovery didn't mean forgetting the past. It meant learning how to simply enjoy eating again.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: a student's recovery from binge eating disorder

title: London’s Ultra Low Emission Zone cleaned up the city’s air. Then children’s lungs got bigger

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: The share of Londin children with clinically impaired lung function also fell significantly, from 14%, or one in 7, before the ULEZ, to 9%, or one in 11.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: At the end of 2020, a London coroner made history by ruling that air pollution, along with severe asthma, were the causes of death for nine-year-old Ella Kissi-Debrah

evidence_level.evidence: according to a major five-year study recently published in the Lancet Public Health journal

benefit_distribution.evidence: The study tracked the lung development of more than 3,400 children between the ages of 6 and 9, in both London and a comparison site of Luton

change_durability.evidence: after five years of the ULEZ, those children’s lungs have improved

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: London's Ultra Low Emission Zone improving children's lung growth

title: Celebrated at birth, pushed into sex work

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Savitri's daughters are preparing for police and medical entrance exams, and a friend of Saniya is continuing her studies after resisting family pressure.

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: In Sagargram, a group of mostly college-going youth formed a committee and were able to stop sex work and liquor inside their village.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: The youth committee in Sagargram successfully resisted the practice, and Saniya helped a friend fight family pressure to continue her studies.

evidence_level.evidence: The article documents specific instances of change: Savitri's daughters are pursuing education, and the Sagargram committee stopped sex work in their village.

benefit_distribution.evidence: The benefits are limited to a few individuals and one village, as most girls in the community remain trapped.

change_durability.evidence: The Sagargram committee has been active for about four years and has sustained its efforts, indicating some durability.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: efforts to end the tradition of pushing Banchhada girls into sex work

title: Unifesp identifica resíduo compatível com sangue no antigo DOI-Codi/SP

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Os resultados obtidos em uma antiga enfermaria e em salas de interrogatório levaram à identificação de resíduos hemáticos. Em uma das amostras, coletada em uma antiga sala de interrogatório, a sala 7, um teste confirmatório apresentou resultado positivo para sangue humano.

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: A pesquisa integra um projeto interinstitucional coordenado por pesquisadores da Unifesp, da Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) e da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), com participação da UFSC e da USP.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: A relação entre as datas registradas e os dias da semana indicou inicialmente duas possibilidades para a produção do calendário: 1970 e 1981. “Essa ambiguidade pôde ser resolvida pelo cruzamento com o testemunho de uma ex-presa política, que declarou ter visto a inscrição quando esteve detida no local, em 1971, permitindo atribuir o calendário a 1970”, informou a Unifesp.

evidence_level.evidence: Em uma das amostras, coletada em uma antiga sala de interrogatório, a sala 7, um teste confirmatório apresentou resultado positivo para sangue humano.

benefit_distribution.evidence: A pesquisa integra um projeto interinstitucional coordenado por pesquisadores da Unifesp, da Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) e da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), com participação da UFSC e da USP.

change_durability.evidence: A primeira etapa do projeto de pesquisa, realizada em 2022, utilizou radar de penetração no solo e escaneamento tridimensional do complexo. Em agosto de 2023, foram conduzidas escavações, prospecção nas paredes e nos pisos, análises forenses e atividades abertas ao público.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: forensic identification of blood residue and a calendar at the former DOI-Codi/SP torture center
